summary.text: Travis Jack Stevens is an unaffiliated write-in candidate. He is a nurse and massage therapist who lives near Rehoboth Beach and describes his campaign as people-funded, built around daily public letters to Delaware voters.

paragraphs.text: According to his Ballotpedia survey response, Travis Stevens was born in Hagerstown, Maryland, to a working-class family.

He has worked for years as a nurse and, according to his campaign website, has been a registered nurse since 2012, including four years as a travel ICU nurse, three of them at David Grant Medical Center, a Department of Defense hospital on Travis Air Force Base.
He worked in a COVID unit in Delaware during the pandemic.
His campaign website says he founded the CAMP Rehoboth Cares Committee and is a former secretary of the Eastern Sussex Democrats.
He now works as a massage therapist, lives near Rehoboth Beach and sings with the CAMP Rehoboth Chorus.
Stevens publishes a series of daily public letters to Delaware voters at travisjackstevens.com covering healthcare, foreign policy, housing and democratic reform.
The Delaware Department of Elections lists his write-in candidacy for U.S. Senate as qualified.
